8/S0.subgoal: Explain the purpose of a VR system and identify the technological and psychological issues behind it, naming immersion and presence as the corresponding concerns.

8/S1.subgoal: Define immersion and explain its six qualities: extensive, matching, surrounding, vivid, interactive, and plot-informing.

8/S2.subgoal: Define presence and explain it as the subjective psychological state of failing to acknowledge the role of technology in the experience.

8/S3.subgoal: Distinguish immersion from presence and explain how immersion influences presence and the overall goal of a VR system.

8/S4.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and note that other VR and AR issues will be covered next.

goal.goal: Explain the purpose of a VR system and characterize its central technological and psychological issues through the definitions, qualities, differences, and relationship of immersion and presence.
goal.achieves: Provides the foundational human-factor concepts needed to understand and address XR challenges, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system.

objectives.goal: Characterize the main issues of a VR system as immersion and presence by explaining the system’s purpose, their definitions, their qualities, their differences, and their relationship.
objectives.achieves: Establishes the foundational human-factor vocabulary needed to evaluate VR experiences and to study later XR issues, human factors, and optimization.
